comment: Frozen inventory of the pre-split CI workflow. Re-derived from source.commit by scripts/ci_inventory_test.py on every run. Later CI changes go in `amendments` ({op: add|remove, platform, step, reason}).

step.name: Trust the exact checkout in the Swift container
Install runtime dependencies
step.run:
apt-get update
apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip sudo poppler-utils imagemagick procps curl xz-utils zip unzip

step.name: Install Node.js LTS (nodejs.org, SHASUMS256-verified) for the live Playwright bootstrap check
step.run:
set -euo pipefail
VERSION="$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(next(e["version"] for e in json.load(sys.stdin) if isinstance(e.get("lts"), str)))')"
FILE="node-${VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz"
curl -fsSLO "https://nodejs.org/dist/${VERSION}/${FILE}"
curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/${VERSION}/SHASUMS256.txt" | grep " ${FILE}\$" | sha256sum -c -
mkdir -p /opt/node && tar -xJf "${FILE}" -C /opt/node --strip-components=1
echo "/opt/node/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
/opt/node/bin/node --version
